question: Is the laboratory qualified?
method_or_setup: EHS review + equipment calibration + fixture datasheet
required_record: Training record; SDS; risk assessment; equipment calibration; waste plan
pass_gate: All hazards controlled and equipment within calibration
stop_condition: Any missing control or unapproved operation

question: Can Mn3O4 precursor be reproduced?
source_condition_or_target: 0.700 g MnCl2·4H2O; 140 mL DI water; NaOH solution 0.123 g/mL at 0.167 mL/min for 50 min; 30 min further reaction
required_record: Raw batch log; pump trace; pH; precipitate appearance; yield; wash/dry history
pass_gate: 3 independent batches with consistent phase and documented yield
stop_condition: Unknown phase / poor repeatability / unsafe process deviation

question: Can target sodium birnessite be made?
method_or_setup: NaOH:Mn3O4 molar ratio screen and 270 C air furnace step
source_condition_or_target: Test ratios 0.5/1/1.5/2/4; paper found Na/Mn approx. 0.27 at ratio 4
required_record: Masses; furnace trace; XRD; ICP-OES/MS; TGA; SEM
pass_gate: Confirmed birnessite phase and measured Na/Mn near target across replicates
stop_condition: Residual phases / ratio outside agreed uncertainty / uncontrolled contamination

question: Can repeat the reported electrode loading?
source_condition_or_target: 5.00 mg active + 1.25 mg carbon per 15 mm disc; two discs per cell
required_record: Substrate grade/thickness; solids masses; area; slurry solids fraction; dry mass; sheet resistance
pass_gate: Mass and loading variation within lab-defined tolerance across >=3 electrodes
column10: unacceptable variation or unsafe dust exposure

question: Is electrolyte composition controlled?
method_or_setup: 1 M Na2SO4 with analytical concentration and pH/conductivity measurement
source_condition_or_target: 150 uL per cell; stock prepared on final volume basis
required_record: Lot/COA; mass; final volume; pH; conductivity; water grade
pass_gate: Concentration and contamination documented within lab's analytical tolerance

question: What is the stable potential range?
method_or_setup: Three-electrode CV/galvanostatic with gas monitoring as appropriate
source_condition_or_target: Published 0.1 M Na2SO4 half-cell reference; CV reported −1.25 to +1.25 V vs Ag/AgCl
required_record: Reference calibration; CV curves; current; potential; temperature; pH; gas observations
pass_gate: Reproducible redox response and safe operating range independently established

question: Can cell architecture be reproduced?
method_or_setup: Two identical electrodes + cellulose separator + aqueous electrolyte in documented split-cell fixture
required_record: 2 x 1.25 mg carbon; 150 uL 1 M Na2SO4; 15 mm electrode discs
pass_gate: Fixture ID; gasket/separator dimensions; compression; electrolyte volume; raw cycler data
stop_condition: 3 replicates with reversible charge/discharge and no leakage/short

question: Can the paper's elevated full-cell voltage window be safely tested?
method_or_setup: Only after Gate T05 and fixture/gas review; stepwise potential-window expansion
source_condition_or_target: Paper reports a 2.5 V full-cell window; do not assume this is safe for a new fixture/material lot
required_record: Gas monitoring; pressure; temperature; voltage; impedance; visual inspection
pass_gate: No uncontrolled gas/pressure and acceptable degradation under approved test plan
stop_condition: Any gas/pressure hazard or evidence of water decomposition outside control

question: What is the rate/capacity trade-off?
method_or_setup: Galvanostatic tests at defined specific-current basis
source_condition_or_target: Paper reports 1/2/5/10 A/g; full-cell normalization basis must be confirmed
required_record: Absolute current; chosen mass denominator; voltage curve; capacity; energy; temperature
pass_gate: Repeatable trend across replicates with explicit denominator
stop_condition: Normalization cannot be reconciled or cells show unsafe behaviour

question: Does performance persist?
method_or_setup: Long-cycle test after safe window and rate gates
pass_gate: All cycle records; coulombic/energy efficiency; impedance checkpoints; failures
stop_condition: Report actual result with mean/SD; no extrapolation to 5

question: Can an external operator reproduce?
method_or_setup: Second operator/lab repeats material and cell work
